# Inventory contract fixtures

These five minimal fixtures retain fictional reference/answer inputs and exact raw parser outputs from the internal 2026-09-24 inventory-v1-repeated reports. Only fields needed by the six archived contract assertions are retained; provider metadata, timing and unrelated report fields are excluded. No model is called, no raw output is repaired, and no assertion is skipped.

Files 3 and 8 test non-fact assessments; 13 tests invalid review fields; 17 tests missing evidence; 9 covers accepted primary and review outputs. These are test examples, not real customer records or deployment credentials.
